items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I filled in for Willie Pontio several times when he was at the Budweiser.

ctx.x: Did you ever play anything with, maybe you mentioned it already, the Jitney jobs?
Well, I filled in there, I filled in for Willie Pontio several times when he was at the Budweiser. Oh yeah.
